name: What are the common challenges during sliding glass door installation, and how are they addressed?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges during sliding glass door installation, and how are they addressed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during sliding glass door installation include ensuring a perfectly plumb and square opening, addressing unexpected structural issues behind existing walls, and achieving a watertight seal to prevent leaks. Proper flashing, insulation, and precise leveling are critical. We address these by conducting thorough pre-installation assessments, applying our decades of experience in structural integration, and utilizing meticulous craftsmanship. Our managed process minimizes surprises and ensures a durable, high-performance installation from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges like achieving a plumb opening, structural issues, and watertight sealing are addressed through pre-assessments, experience, and meticulous craftsmanship for a durable installation.
